articleTitle: You're Not Ruining Your Baby by Skipping Drowsy But Awake
imageHeadline: High-Need Baby? You Don't Have to Do Drowsy But Awake

pinTitle: drowsy but awake alternatives for high need babies that actually work
pinDescription: If drowsy but awake isn't working for your baby, you're not doing anything wrong. Research supports flexible sleep approaches for high-need babies. Get the full breakdown of what actually works and why one method isn't a requirement for healthy sleep.
